assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis codes I48.0 and I47.1 are associated with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment to characterize arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded with CPT 93271.
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary to support the diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia as documented in the clinical indication note.
The medical necessity of the claim should be reconsidered based on the patient's documented symptoms and diagnosis codes.
